description: This file defines internal structures and classes for Android's Binder IPC mechanism, including AIBinder interface, local and remote binder implementations, class descriptors, and death recipient management.

classes.name: AIBinder
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a binder object, either local or remote.

classes.name: ABBinder
classes.description: Concrete class for local binder objects with known class and implementation.

classes.name: ABpBinder
classes.description: Binder wrapper for remote or external binder objects, handles lookup and creation.

classes.name: AIBinder_Class
classes.description: Descriptor for binder interface classes, including interface descriptor and transaction handlers.

classes.name: AIBinder_DeathRecipient
classes.description: Manages death notifications for binder objects, including linked death recipients.

methods.name: isUserCommand
methods.description: Checks if a transaction code is within the user command range.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class descriptor associated with the binder.

methods.name: associateClass
methods.description: Associates a class descriptor with the binder.

methods.name: getBinder
methods.description: Returns the underlying Android IBinder object.

methods.name: isRemote
methods.description: Checks if the binder is a remote object.

methods.name: getUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with local binder.

methods.name: lookupOrCreateFromBinder
methods.description: Finds or creates a binder wrapper from an existing IBinder.

methods.name: AIBinder_Class constructor
methods.description: Initializes class descriptor with interface info and handlers.

methods.name: getInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the interface descriptor as String16.

methods.name: linkToDeath
methods.description: Links a death recipient to the binder.

methods.name: unlinkToDeath
methods.description: Unlinks a death recipient from the binder.
